target_audience: Neighbors who already walk past the new shop on their way to work
core_feeling: That the roastery down the street is part of their morning, not a chain
call_to_action: Stop in at the second shop this week
key_message: Small batches roasted in our back room, every bag dated, and now a short walk closer.
exclusions: No stock hipster-barista tropes or forced smiles
No claims we cannot source, such as best coffee in town
references: Dziga Vertov, Man with a Movie Camera (1929): a city waking up, observed rather than staged
Morning window light in documentary still photography: one source, honest shadows
Room tone of a working roastery: drum rumble, beans cracking, a door bell
